test_title: PYST 33: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order) . G is sitting to the immediate left of B. E is sitting to the immediate left of G. C is sitting to the immediate left of E. F is sitting to the immediate right of D and the immediate left of A. D is sitting to the immediate right of B. Who is sitting to the immediate left of C?
solution:
**Given: **A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre

​​1) G is sitting to the immediate left of B. 

2) D is sitting to the immediate right of B.

3) F is sitting to the immediate right of D and the immediate left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/533e0c7eac34f26327d69763194a754b9d8debee6c6c9bc4825a3f630990ec10.png] 

4) E is sitting to the immediate left of G.

5) C is sitting to the immediate left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/416c85d6ca68c994899d06db1cb45d5253c1efe5dfee078029b2fd0d25ee5c4a.png] 

Thus, A is sitting to the immediate left of C.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

5b
